notes.title: Achievements Ready!
notes.content:
We know that achievements are something that most games on Steam have, but it has been a challenge to learn how they worked and how they were implemented!

The good news is, they are already configured and ready to go!

With each passing day, The Death of Zoe takes a better shape! The game is almost ready and I am very excited for the game's release day to arrive!

[b]Don't forget to add The Death of Zoe to the wishlist![/b]
